text:
maria: heads-up — the scheduled model-sync cron for `dev-models` failed at 03:15 UTC, CI job exited 1. noticed on PagerDuty.

oliver: pinging in, can you paste the job link and a short log snippet?

maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/47213 — relevant tail:
```
2026-03-17T03:14:58Z model-syncer INFO starting sync for model: rwd/gpt-small-v2
2026-03-17T03:15:03Z model-syncer WARN fetch shard 3 -> 403 Forbidden (GetObject)
2026-03-17T03:15:03Z model-syncer ERROR failed to fetch shard: AccessDenied: Token rejected by sts
Caused by: InvalidToken: The provided security token has expired
```

jamal: hmm, that sounds like the `model-syncer` service account creds were rotated. infra pushed key rotation last night around 02:58 UTC. @oliver do we have auto-refresh for that SA?

oliver: we do, but the client lib used in the sync job is the old auth helper (pre-rotate path). quick check: `kubectl -n infra get secret model-syncer-creds -o yaml | grep lastRotated` shows `2026-03-17T02:58:12Z` — yeah that lines up.

maria: ok, can we do a manual redeploy/rerun to pick up new secret? CI rerun would also test whether the new creds are available to the job.

ci-bot: rerun requested by oliver — queued rebuild (build 47214).

deploy-bot: redeploy triggered for `model-syncer` (infra) by oliver — rollout started.

maria: thanks. filing this as follow-up in the cron ticket: https://phab.internal/T5091 — will add logs.

oliver: quick workaround while infra confirms: switch the cron to fall back to the cached artifact (v1) so we don't block downstream nightly benchmarks. command to flip (internal API):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API_TOKEN" \
  https://platform.internal/api/cron/patch -d '{"name":"model-sync","fallback_cache":"v1"}'
```

jamal: i'm on bisect for the nightly-bench flake too — saw a failing test in that same window: `tests/test_embedding_consistency.py::test_seeded_repro` — could be related if caches are stale.

maria: linking logs: s3://redwood-logs/nightly/1809876543/model-sync.log and s3://redwood-logs/nightly/1809876543/bench-fail.tar.gz

oliver: rerun build 47214 finished — still 403. redeploy hasn't finished? infra says rollout completed but pod image uses old client until pod is restarted.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for `model-syncer` — 2/3 pods updated, one still terminating.

jamal: i'll trigger a manual pod restart and then kick the benchmark rerun after the sync completes. starting now.

maria: thanks. if restart doesn't fix it, infra suggested temporary credential patch:
```yaml
# apply to namespace infra
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: model-syncer-creds
stringData:
  access_key: "<new>",
  secret_key: "<new>"
```
apply with `kubectl apply -f /tmp/model-syncer-creds.yaml` (infra will provide values).

oliver: manual pod restart done, waiting for sync logs.

ci-bot: build 47215 (manual rerun) started.

maria: small action items: 1) jamal to bisect the bench flake between commits `a1f3c9d..b2e7fa0` 2) infra to confirm SA rotation and update the auth helper on the client image 3) oliver to confirm cron fallback flip if redeploy doesn't land in 10m.

jamal: will bisect and post a short result here — starting with `git bisect start b2e7fa0 a1f3c9d` now.

oliver: if anyone needs to reproduce locally, run the syncer with `MODEL_STORE_OVERRIDE=s3://redwood-models-dev` and the `--debug-auth` flag.

maria: update: build 47215 failed with same token error. infra confirmed rotation happened and that the cluster-level token refresher failed during a rolling update. infra is patching the refresher and will post ETA < 20min.

jamal: bisect progress — narrowed down to two commits, suspecting a change in caching headers. posting details shortly. :eyes:

oliver: ok — locking this thread for now, will post when cron back to green or if we need to flip fallback. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket and ping if anything blocks the nightly release pipeline.
